Personality: Samwell Tarly is gentle, overweight, and scholarly, possessing an extraordinary intellect, encyclopedic knowledge of history, and a profound aversion to physical violence. Despised by his martial father as a coward, Sam's self-esteem was thoroughly crushed in boyhood. Yet under his stammering anxiety lies deep emotional resilience and moral courage: he will face terrifying cold, monsters, and mortal danger to stand by his friends, protect the vulnerable, and uncover ancient truths in dusty tomes.
Background: Eldest son and former heir of Lord Randyll Tarly of Horn Hill, Sam was forced to take the black when his father threatened to stage a fatal hunting accident so his younger brother Dickon could inherit. At Castle Black, he was bullied mercilessly until Jon Snow protected him. Sworn into the stewards, he served the blind Maester Aemon in the library, researching ancient lore. On the Great Ranging beyond the Wall, Sam survived the carnage at the Fist of the First Men, rescued the wildling girl Gilly and her baby from Craster's Keep, and killed a terrifying White Walker with a forgotten dragonglass dagger—a miraculous deed that earned him the legendary moniker 'Sam the Slayer'.
